# Benchmark International Middle Market

> Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States with $50M–$500M in total enterprise value (TEV) in sell-side M&A, majority and control transactions and strategic partnerships, across five industries: Industrial, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare, Technology.

Information as of October 2026. Contact: 813-771-6675, mmt@benchmarkintl.com. Parent firm: Benchmark International (https://www.benchmarkintl.com/).

## Industries
- [Industrial](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/industrial.html): Manufacturing, industrial distribution, building products, energy and environmental services, and transportation.
- [Business Services](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/business-services.html): Commercial and facility services, marketing and tech-enabled services, engineering and consulting, financial and insurance services, and staffing and human capital.
- [Consumer](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/consumer.html): Food and beverage (including restaurants), consumer brands and products, foodservice and distribution, and consumer services.
- [Healthcare](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/healthcare.html): Provider services, life sciences and diagnostics, medical products and distribution, and pharmacy and healthcare services.
- [Technology](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/technology.html): Vertical software, enterprise and infrastructure software, IT and managed services, and communications and hardware.

## Industry reports
- [Industrial Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Order books are full, the deal market has become more selective and buyers are paying the most for power, data center, aerospace and service revenue.
- [Business Services Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Mergers and acquisitions across commercial, professional and human capital services.
- [Consumer Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Strategic and financial buyers stayed active across the consumer industry through the third quarter, and they are paying for brands and operators that have held price and volume while the cost of financing a purchase rises.
- [Healthcare Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Mergers and acquisitions across provider services, life sciences, medical products and pharmacy services.
- [Technology Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Data center demand is filling order books, consolidators keep paying for recurring revenue, and government contractors are working through a slower award calendar.

## Common questions
- **What does Benchmark International's Middle Market team do?** Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States in sell-side M&A, majority and control transactions and strategic partnerships.
- **What size companies does the Middle Market team advise?** The team serves privately held companies with a total enterprise value (TEV) of $50 million to $500 million.
- **Which industries does the Middle Market team focus on?** Five industries: Industrial, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare and Technology.
- **What services does the Middle Market team provide?** Services include sell-side M&A, majority and control transactions, strategic partnerships, and exit planning and valuation.
- **How does working with Benchmark International start?** The first step is always a confidential conversation about your goals, your company and your options. A senior member of the Middle Market team sets up a private conversation, then walks you through the paths available, from a full sale to a strategic partnership.
- **How large is Benchmark International?** Benchmark International is the #1 privately owned sell-side M&A advisor worldwide, based on PitchBook's Q2 2026 Global League Tables, with 15 offices across the Americas, Europe and Africa.
- **How do I contact the Middle Market team?** Call 813-771-6675 or email mmt@benchmarkintl.com.
